subject.title: Preview session workspace images and unsupported files

question: Should the session workspace feature owner approve this additive preview contract for merge now that the prior documentation finding is fixed?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but the protected maintainer label requires explicit human ownership review rather than automated landing.

options.title: Approve the preview contract
options.body: Accept the optional metadata fields and bounded content-sniffed image behavior as the canonical extension of sessions.files.get.

options.title: Revise the protocol shape
options.body: Request a narrower or differently owned metadata contract before merge if native-client responsibilities should differ.

recommendation.title: Approve the preview contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional metadata fields and bounded content-sniffed image behavior as the canonical extension of sessions.files.get.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the session workspace viewer/editor and Gateway contract extended by this PR.
